name: 幼蛛
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite animation atlas for a tiny summoned baby spider in original dark gothic 2D anime fantasy game 秘境决斗. A NON-HUMANOID real spider monster: two connected body segments, round dark plum abdomen with a muted gold marking, small charcoal cephalothorax, two tiny lavender eyes, EXACTLY EIGHT thin articulated chitin legs in four pairs, two short fangs. NO human torso, face, arms, clothing, crown or wings. Cute-menacing game creature, readable silhouette, hand-painted detailed ink style matching gothic fantasy bestiary. Produce a SQUARE genuinely transparent PNG, target 2048x2048, EXACTLY 4 equal columns by 4 equal rows, 16 independent poses, no visible grid, NO text or numbers. Every pose side-facing RIGHT, consistent size and shape. Each FULL spider must fit local x20%..80%, y25%..85% of its cell, with at least 15% transparent clearance on every side INCLUDING spread legs. Same scale and local center x50%, ground foot baseline y85% in every frame. Never cross or touch a cell boundary. Six successive distinct spider-walk cycle poses in cells0..5, alternating four-legged support groups to make a coherent loop. Cell6 idle ready. Cell7 rear up attack windup. Cell8 forward fangs lunge. Cell9 recover. Cell10 tiny mouth venom spitting posture without a long projectile. Cell11 emerging/crawling OUT of an egg posture (ONLY spider, NO actual egg object). Cell12 flinch. Cell13 heavy stagger. Cell14 collapse. Cell15 lying dead on its side, all limbs remain attached, no gore. All16 drawings must be fully visible and separated by generous transparent gutters, no shadows, backgrounds, labels, atmosphere or borders. This is a reusable actual game sprite atlas, not a reference board. Avoid oversized limbs, detached legs, impossible joints or extra legs.
